title: C4OS Grill Question 027 - Attachments First Pass

questions.label: Which attachment types must work in the first pass?
questions.help: Recommended: files, Browser screenshots, and Browser annotations first. Directories and artifacts can follow because they need more context-packaging rules.
options: Files, Browser screenshots, and Browser annotations first
Files, directories, screenshots, annotations, and artifacts

questions.label: How should C4OS handle providers that do not support direct attachments?
questions.help: Recommended: store attachments as C4OS records and let the runtime adapter decide whether to inline, reference, convert, or reject per provider/model.
options: Store C4OS attachment records; runtime adapter translates per provider/model
Only allow attachments supported by the selected provider/model
Convert all attachments to text before sending
Block attachments until provider research is complete

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify file size limits, image/document conversion, screenshot attachment behavior, annotation format, or attachment persistence.
